player_prompt.intro:
You will observe {N} hidden values sequentially.
At each step type [accept] to pick the *current* value, or [continue] to skip it and see the next one.
If you never accept, you are forced to take the final value.
You win (reward = 1) **only** if the value you ultimately pick is the highest of all.

outcome.summary: You accepted value {value} at draw {draw_num}/{N}. The best overall was {best}. {result}
